title: Projektetage Title Auto-Animate Fix
description: Fix title morph from intro slide 1 to 2 in projektetage — title re-enters from bottom instead of reveal.js auto-animate.
summary:
Fixed projektetage title (and other intro morphs) re-entering from the bottom on slide 1→2.

Root cause: reveal.js auto-animate matches both `[data-id]` elements and nested text nodes (`h1`–`h6`, `p`, `li`). We put `data-id` on wrapper `<div>`s with `<h2>` inside, so reveal animated the wrapper and the inner heading separately with the same FLIP translate — compounding ~252px into ~500px+ and looking like the title flew in from below.

Fix: Put `data-id` only on leaf morph targets (h2, p, h4, h5) per reveal.js docs; use `title--0` style ids for multi-line blocks. Verified in browser: single `data-auto-animate-target` on title h2, no wrapper match, transform `translate(0, 251.5px)` only (correct scaled delta from y≈465 to y≈93). All renderer (6) and core (7) tests pass.
